title: Align Custom HTML Block Schema & Metadata Definition
description: Defines block schema (apiVersion 3, name 'align/custom-html', category 'align-category', icon 'html'), attributes ('content' with raw source, 'blockId', 'enableShortcode' default true), supports configuration (html: false, lock: false, customClassName: true), and declares context dependencies (postId, postType, templatePart/slug, templatePart/theme, templateSlug) for 5-tier deep linking.

title: Align Custom HTML Block Editor Card & Placeholder Styles
description: Styles the Gutenberg editor placeholder card (.align-builder-block-placeholder-wrapper, .align-builder-block-card-link) with clean dashed borders, hover transitions, branded purple accent colors (#6366f1, #4f46e5), SVG icon background boxes, and typography matching the Align theme aesthetic.
events_and_hooks: Enqueued as editor style in init.php

title: Align Custom HTML Block Gutenberg Editor Component & Deep-Link Card
description: Implements Gutenberg visual editor component for 'align/custom-html'. Renders a branded placeholder card with the Align SVG logo and 'Edit with Align Builder' link that resolves target context across 5 levels (Parent Block Hierarchy -> props.context -> core/edit-site store -> core/editor store -> URL parameters). Provides InspectorControls sidebar panel for toggling shortcodes, editing custom block DOM IDs, and includes RawHTML save/deprecated definitions.
events_and_hooks: Registered as editor script for align/custom-html in init.php

title: Align Custom HTML Block Registration & Asset Enqueue
description: Registers the 'align/custom-html' block type using block.json metadata, registers and enqueues editor scripts ('align-custom-html-editor') and styles ('align-custom-html-editor-style'), localizes 'AlignVvvebConfig' with the builder URL, and hooks the server-side render callback to 'render.php'.

title: Align Custom HTML Block Dynamic Server-Side Renderer
description: Executes front-end server-side rendering for the 'align/custom-html' block: resolves dynamic permalinks with data-align-link-id, parses builder components and shortcodes (when enableShortcode is true), enqueues external CSS/JS files from disk via Align_Builder_Assets, unescapes legacy wrappers, and outputs clean zero-wrapper HTML for flatter DOM, superior performance, and ADA/SEO optimization.
events_and_hooks: Render callback for align/custom-html block (invoked via init.php)

title: Align Blocks Master Loader & Custom Category Registrar
description: Loads all dynamic Gutenberg block modules (custom-html, query-builder, live-search, element, media, marquee, breadcrumb, share, icon) and registers the custom 'Align Builder' block category ('align-category') via the 'block_categories_all' filter hook.

title: Canvas Iframe Container & Responsive Scale Stylesheet
description: Controls iframe wrapper positioning (#canvas #iframe-wrapper), responsive scales and background borders, search inputs with clear-backspace buttons, and add-section popup dimensions.

title: Core Layout, Typography & Global Reset Stylesheet
description: Defines overall flex container structure (#container, #content, .main, .sidebar), logo branding container, navigation links, line-awesome icons, and submenu hover states.

title: Top, Left & Right Panels Layout Stylesheet
description: Manages #top-panel (position: relative, overflow: visible) to ensure responsive dropdown menus are never clipped, styles left panel FileManager (#filemanager) and component lists, styles right panel properties inspector (#right-panel), and provides vibrant primary styling for the Save button (.save-btn).

title: Sidebar Navigation Menus & Collapsed Mode Stylesheet
description: Styles sidebar navigation menus, dropdown sub-menus, dark mode hover colors, user profile box, and collapsed small navigation mode (.small-nav).

title: Drag-and-Drop Elements & Component List Stylesheet
description: Controls visual states for drag-and-drop element tiles (li[data-type]), sidebar drag containers, component icons and dark mode inversions.

title: Hover Highlight Box & Canvas Centering Stylesheet
description: Styles the element hover boundary (#highlight-box), element tag name badge (#highlight-name), drop target border (#drop-highlight-box), selection box (#select-box), and locks #canvas to middle alignment (align-items: center, transform-origin: center center).

title: Autocomplete Dropdowns & Zoom Percent Stylesheet
description: Styles autocomplete popup results (ul.autocomplete), tags input elements (.tags-input .tag), zoom percent input (.percent), and section background video overlays.

title: Inspector Base Input Controls & Toggle Switches Stylesheet
description: Core stylesheet for inspector input controls, autocomplete, locked link/media cards, and flex row alignment for toggle switch controls (label on left, switch on right with preserved column gutter padding).

title: Inspector Select, Breadcrumbs & Floating Tree Stylesheet
description: Styles select dropdowns, breadcrumb trail (.breadcrumb-navigator), tooltips (.hint), and floating Tree Navigator positioning inside #canvas.

title: Modals, Code Editor Popup & Action Buttons Stylesheet
description: Styles modal dialogs, modal-backdrop blur filter, CodeMirror 6 code editor popup (#codeEditorModal), nav-pills tabs, and button icons (.btn-icon, .btn-primary, .btn-outline-secondary).

title: Selection Box & Topbar Actions Toolbar Stylesheet
description: Positions the selection actions toolbar (#select-actions) within the top-panel, styles the selected element badge (#top-select-element-badge), overwrite toggle button (#toggle-overwrite-btn), resize handles, and canvas inline WYSIWYG editor (#wysiwyg-editor).

title: SortableJS Swap Highlights & Drop Target Stylesheet
description: Defines SortableJS swap highlights (.sortable-swap-highlight), fallback drag ghost (.sortable-fallback), chosen item (.sortable-chosen), and drop indicators.

title: DOM Tree Navigator & Sidebar Panes Stylesheet
description: Styles the DOM hierarchy tree (#tree-list), folder items, section controls with drag handles and action buttons (duplicate/delete), header alignment controls, and enforces strict single-line white-space nowrap and text-overflow ellipsis across tree node labels to prevent multi-line text breaking and overlapping.

title: WordPress Media Library Modal Scoping & Accessibility Stylesheet
description: Provides complete CSS isolation for the WordPress Media Library modal (.media-modal, .media-modal-backdrop), screen reader accessibility utilities (.screen-reader-text), search input styling, attachment grid checkboxes, router navigation tabs, and attachment sidebar details.

title: Align Theme Builder Master Stylesheet Entrypoint
description: Master CSS aggregator imported by the builder host. Imports vendor fonts (line-awesome.css, bootstrap-custom.css), base layouts (editor-layout, editor-sidebar, editor-panels, editor-canvas), component interactions (editor-tree-navigator, editor-highlight-box, editor-select-actions, editor-drag-elements, editor-sortable-drop), inspector inputs (editor-inputs-base, editor-inputs-select, editor-inputs-autocomplete), modals/media (editor-modals-toolbar, editor-wp-media), and themes (editor-sections-theme, editor-dark-theme).

title: Dark Theme Stylesheet & Custom Variable Overrides
description: Full dark theme overrides for Align Builder UI, modals, component tree navigator, media cards, and toggle switches.

title: Section Presets & Inspector Accordion Headers Stylesheet
description: Styles accordion header bars (label.header, input.header_check), toggle switches (.toggle, .toggle-switch), CSS unit selectors (.input-group.css-unit), and button groups.

title: Custom Bootstrap Framework & Icon Glyph Stylesheet
description: Core Bootstrap framework CSS combined with custom SVG component icon glyphs (.icon-*) referencing ../../libs/builder/icons/.

title: Line Awesome Vector Icon Font Stylesheet
description: Vendor icon stylesheet providing the entire Line Awesome icon suite (.la, .las, .lab, .lar) and glyph font definitions used throughout builder panels, tree navigator, and inspector inputs.

title: Canvas Iframe Helpers & Isolated Floating Action Dock
description: Scoped stylesheet loaded inside the canvas iframe and host. Enforces non-editable area overlays ([data-vvveb-disabled]), disables iframe mouse events for embedded components (lottie, oembed, video, maps), renders empty column drop targets ('Drag elements here'), and provides strict CSS isolation for the fixed bottom floating action dock (#vvvebjs-new-section) with blur backdrop filter.

title: Align Blocks Canvas Layout, Hover Outlines & Turn-based Layered Z-Index
description: Styles custom Align blocks on the Gutenberg editor canvas with zero padding/margin for 1:1 front-end layout synchronization. Provides turn-based layered z-index (10 to 50) for nested blocks, dashed hover outlines (#94a3b8), bright accent selection outlines (#2563eb), and top-left overlapping title badges displaying 'attr(data-type)' with backdrop blur.

depends_on: WordPress Gutenberg Block Editor Canvas DOM

title: Gutenberg Content Blur, Post Title Protection & Edit Overlay Styles
description: Provides stylesheet rules for the Gutenberg visual editor: protects post title elements (.wp-block-post-title, .editor-post-title) from blurring, applies optional content blurring (.align-builder-blurred-canvas), and formats the centered 'Edit with Align Builder' overlay modal card (.align-builder-editor-overlay, .align-builder-overlay-card) with animations and branded primary action buttons.

title: Site Editor (FSE) & Block Editor Context Deep-Linker & Toolbar Actions
description: Resolves editing context across 5 tiers (Selected core/template-part block -> core/edit-site store -> core/editor store -> URL parameters -> Path parameters) to deep-link directly into Align Builder with exact post_id or tp_id. Delegates editor mode resolution and header switcher button mounting to AlignEditorModeSwitch, filters 'core/template-part' block edit component to inject floating BlockControls toolbar buttons and InspectorControls sidebar panels, and manages embedded builder iframe mounting.

title: Document Overview Block Tree Auto-Expander & Focus Controller
description: Subscribes to Gutenberg block selection changes via 'wp.data.subscribe' and automatically opens the Document Overview / List View (Block Tree) sidebar panel ('core/editor' -> setIsListViewOpened(true)) when a user selects any block on the canvas, providing immediate hierarchical navigation.

title: Block Duplicate Unique ID Auto-Generator HOC
description: Higher-Order Component filter on 'editor.BlockEdit' for Align dynamic blocks ('align/element', 'align/media'). Recursively inspects all blocks on the canvas to detect duplicate unique identifiers ('elementId', 'videoId', 'imgId') upon block duplication and automatically appends a unique random 4-character suffix, preventing DOM ID collisions.

title: Gutenberg Inspector Controls & Branded Tab Panels Stylesheet
description: Standardizes styling across all Align Gutenberg Block Inspector sidebars. Formats panels (.components-panel__body), typography, text/number/URL inputs, textareas, custom select controls with SVG arrows, primary/secondary action buttons, and implements 100% custom Tab Panels (.align-tab-panel, .align-qb-tab-panel, .align-media-tabs) using direct border-bottom styling while suppressing WordPress Core default ::after indicators.

title: DOM Serializer & Sanitizer Engine
description: Enforces Zero-Preview-Persistence, unwraps runtime animation spacers (.pin-spacer, scroll-spacers), collapses split spans, and sanitizes live canvas DOM nodes or HTML strings before persistence. Maintains strict HTML5/SVG attribute allowlist, strips browser extension injected tags (Grammarly, Loom), eliminates internal editor helper widgets (#vvvebjs-new-section, newsection, helper stylesheets/scripts), normalizes shortcode content, and reports execution benchmarks and stripped attribute metrics.

title: Reusable Block Selection Detector & REST Fetcher
description: Intercepts element selection (Vvveb.Builder.selectNode, Vvveb.Components.render, right-panel input), parses Reusable Block ID and instance key (default or custom instance attribute), handles fetch deduplication for REST API /fields, manages master template baseline cache, and determines whether to render Live DOM Overwrite or API Field Overwrite accordion.

title: REST API Fields Content Overwrite Inspector Accordion
description: Renders the Content Overwrite accordion based on field definitions returned by the REST API (/wp-json/align-reuse/v1/fields). Allows editing image/video sources, button text, links, and text content when the Reusable Block is unrendered or encapsulated. Syncs changes directly to live canvas DOM (applyFieldToCanvas) and tracks changes in _alignActiveReuseOverrides.

title: Live DOM Content Overwrite Inspector Accordion
description: Renders the Content Overwrite accordion in the right inspector panel for elements currently rendered in canvas DOM marked with data-allow-overwrite='true' or data-overwrite-id. Supports media (image, video, picture), buttons, links (text, href, target), and typography (text, textarea). Provides real-time Modified badges, individual reset to master defaults, Reset All to Default, and syncs _alignActiveReuseOverrides.

title: Reusable Block Content Overwrite Ajax Link Picker
description: Renders and binds the debounced Ajax Link Picker for Reusable Block Link Overwrites. Supports Unlocked state (debounced search via /wp-json/align-builder/v1/search-links, direct URL typing) and Locked state (card with #<ID> badge, post title, and disconnect button). Guarantees post IDs (data-align-link-id) are stored for accurate dynamic permalink resolution.

title: WordPress Components Shadow DOM Live Preview & Dynamic Widget Bootstrapper
description: Provides isolated Open Shadow DOM preview rendering for WordPress Shortcodes, Gutenberg Blocks, and Post Content placeholders. Handles REST preview fetching with deduplication, asset injection, dummy image replacement, and dynamic widget script bootstrapping (e.g. AlignLiveSearch).

title: WordPress Pages & Templates FileManager Router
description: Fetches page and template lists from WordPress REST API (/pages), formats them into Vvveb.FileManager registry, handles folder categorization (Pages, Templates, Template Parts, Reusable Blocks), and routes clicks into clean query param navigation (post_id, tp_id). Displays and provides one-click clipboard copy with feedback for Reusable Block shortcodes in #top-panel.

title: WordPress Environment & Branding Initializer
description: Initializes the builder UI environment by applying saved dark mode state from localStorage to documentElement data-bs-theme, toggling Moon/Sun icons on .btn-dark-mode, rendering dynamic WordPress site icon / theme screenshot into #wp-site-icon and favicon link, and updating document.title with builder and site names.

title: WordPress Items Create and Delete UI Manager
description: Manages creation, deletion, and renaming of WordPress Pages, Templates, Template Parts, and Reusable Blocks. Controls Add dropdown (#new-item-toggle, #add-item-menu), handles modal dialogues (#align-create-item-modal, #align-rename-item-modal), attaches delete/rename hooks to filemanager tree items using MutationObserver, and handles asynchronous REST operations.

title: WordPress Media Library Modal Bridge
description: Overrides MediaModal.prototype.open to integrate native WordPress Media Library (wp.media). Resolves responsive image breakpoint dimensions (Mobile <=589px: 375w, Tablet 590-991px: 768w, Desktop >=992px: 1200w), generates dynamic srcset attributes, unwrap picture tags, assigns wp-image-{id} classes, and updates live inspector preview thumbnails.

title: Reusable Block Content Overwrite Master Namespace Stub
description: Defines the base namespace window.AlignBuilderModules.WpReuseBlockOverwrite and initializes fieldsCache before submodules (detector, inspector-live, inspector-api) extend it with Object.assign.

title: Revision Comparison Studio & Unified Master Scroll Controller
description: Manages fullscreen Revision Comparison Studio with dual independent revision selectors (Base vs Target), Side-by-Side and Single preview modes, and a Unified Single Master Scroll Controller with custom master scrollbar for 60fps/120fps lockstep iframe synchronization and 1-click revision rollback.

title: REST API Page & Template Save Handler
description: Handles page, template, and reusable block saving. Flushes pending CodeMirror debounce timers, extracts live canvas HTML via AlignSerializer, reads CSS from StyleManager, reads JS from JsManager, applies non-destructive image/video lazyload (decoding='async', loading='lazy'), collects cascading reusable block overrides (_alignActiveReuseOverrides), and posts JSON payload to /save endpoint with button visual state feedback.

title: Dynamic Style Injector & Dummy Image Replacement
description: Monitors canvas iframe load lifecycle (Vvveb.iframe.loaded) and injects active theme CSS stylesheets and custom CSS with data-vvveb-helpers='true'. Sanitizes and replaces dummy placeholder images in canvas DOM (img, picture source, video poster, iframe, background-image) with picsum placeholder while protecting dynamic components, shortcodes, and shadow roots.

title: Centralized Toolbar Tooltip Manager & Browser Tooltip Suppressor
description: Manages Bootstrap 5 tooltips across top-panel and select-actions toolbars. Prevents native browser tooltip conflicts by stripping title attributes into data-bs-original-title, ensures proper hide lifecycle on click/selection changes/escape key, handles iframe canvas clicks and scrolls, and provides MutationObserver-driven dynamic title synchronization.

title: VvvebJs WordPress Integration Master Bundle Loader
description: Master bootstrap script that executes on DOMContentLoaded. Ensures sidebar control groups (components, blocks, sections, styles) are loaded into Vvveb.Builder, and initializes all client modules in sequence: WpInit, WpMediaModal, WpSaveHandler, WpItemsCrud, WpFilemanager, and WpReuseBlockOverwrite.

title: Block Presets: Online User Avatar & 3D Flip Team Cards
description: Registers block templates: 'bootstrap4/user-online' (circular online status avatar with gradient border and live pulse indicator) and 'bootstrap4/our-team' (6-member 3D card flip showcase with front avatar/title and backside description with social links).

title: Block Presets: 3-Tier Pricing Table & Circular CSS Loader
description: Registers block templates: 'bootstrap4/pricing-1' (3-tier responsive subscription pricing tables with danger/warning/success color coding, feature checklist, and CTA buttons) and 'bootstrap4/loading-circle' (pure CSS 4-tier rotating multi-color spinner).

title: Block Presets: Multi-Tab Login & About Team Sections
description: Registers block templates: 'bootstrap4/login-form' (comprehensive multi-tab authorization widget with Sign In, Sign Up, and account switching tabs with profile avatars) and 'bootstrap4/about-team' (4-column team member profile cards).

title: Block Presets: Transition Product Cards
description: Registers 'bootstrap4/product-card' block template in Vvveb.Blocks featuring 3-column product showcase cards with badge indicators (low KMS, fully-loaded, price reduced), year badges, detail price tags, hover elevation box-shadows, and yellow CTA buttons.

title: Block Presets: Quote Box & Newsletter Subscription Bar
description: Registers block templates: 'bootstrap4/block-quote' (teal card quote box with large quotation mark, quote text, author, and love counter badge) and 'bootstrap4/subscribe-newsletter' (gradient CTA banner with email input and submit button).

title: Bootstrap Base Spacing, Sizing, Borders & Background Styles
description: Extends the base component with fundamental Box Model and CSS styling controls: Size (width, height, min/max dimensions), Margin (top, right, bottom, left), Padding (top, right, bottom, left), Border (style solid/dotted/dashed, width, color), Border Radius (4 corners), and Background Image (image URL, repeat, size cover/contain, position X/Y).

title: Bootstrap Base Typography, Display, Positioning & Colors
description: Extends the base component with core CSS typography and layout attributes: General (Id, Class), Display (block, inline, inline-block, none), Position (static, fixed, relative, absolute, top, left, bottom, right), Float, Opacity slider, Background & Text Color pickers, and Typography controls (font-size, font-weight 100-900, font-family, text-align, line-height, letter-spacing, text-decoration line/color/style).

title: Bootstrap Buttons, Button Groups & Toolbars
description: Registers standard Bootstrap 4/5 button components: html/button (href LinkInput, type variants btn-primary/success/danger/outline-*, size btn-lg/sm, target, disabled toggle), html/buttongroup (horizontal/vertical alignment and size), and html/buttontoolbar (grouped button clusters).

title: Bootstrap Alerts, Badges, Cards & List Groups
description: Registers Bootstrap UI containers: html/alert (alert-dismissible with type presets primary/warning/danger/success), html/badge (contextual badge indicators), html/card (card structure with card-img-top, card-body, title, text, action button), html/listgroup (list-group container), and html/listitem (list-group-item with badge count).

title: Bootstrap Forms & Form Control Widgets
description: Extends form inputs with Bootstrap styling: html/form (form styles default, search, inline, horizontal), html/textinput (form-control wrapper with label and type dropdown), html/selectinput (custom option manager with live add/remove option rows), html/textareainput, html/radiobutton, html/checkbox, and html/fileinput.

title: Bootstrap Grid Column & Row System
description: Registers responsive column and row layout controllers: html/gridcolumn (dynamic breakpoint column span analyzer col-*, col-sm-*, col-md-*, col-lg-*) and html/gridrow (parent row container with child column inspector list, dynamic add column button, and column remove action).

title: Bootstrap Grid Container Layout
description: Registers html/container component supporting fixed container and fluid full-width container-fluid layouts, contextual background classes (bgcolorClasses), and custom inline background/text color pickers.

title: Bootstrap Navigation Bars, Breadcrumbs & Progress Bars
description: Registers navigation and feedback widgets: html/breadcrumbs, html/breadcrumbitem, html/pagination (alignment and size options), html/pageitem (href link and disabled toggle), html/progress (percentage width w-25..100, contextual background, striped, animated toggles), html/jumbotron, and html/navbar (navbar-light/dark, bg classes, placement fixed-top/bottom/sticky-top).

title: Bootstrap Styled Data Tables
description: Extends HTML tables with Bootstrap classes and modifiers: html/table (type presets table-primary..dark, responsive, small table-sm, hover, bordered, striped, inverse, thead options), html/tablerow, html/tablecell, html/tableheadercell, html/tablehead, and html/tablebody.

title: Bootstrap 5 Cards, Badges, Alerts & List Groups
description: Upgrades UI components to Bootstrap 5 standards: html/alert (uses data-bs-dismiss='alert'), html/badge (uses bg-primary, bg-body-secondary, bg-dark), html/card (modern card anatomy with bg-body-secondary placeholders), html/listgroup (flush, numbered list-group-numbered, horizontal list-group-horizontal toggles), and html/listitem (active, disabled, background variants).

title: Bootstrap 5 Grid Container & Anchor Buttons
description: Registers Bootstrap 5 component group: html/container (container, container-fluid), html/btn (anchor tag styled as button with btn-primary/outline-* classes, size, autofocus, disabled, and link options), html/buttongroup (horizontal/vertical, sizing), and html/buttontoolbar (using me-2 spacing classes).

title: Bootstrap 5 Flexbox Grid Columns & Row Layout
description: Registers enhanced Bootstrap 5 grid layout system: html/gridcolumn (handles col, col-*, col-sm-*, col-md-*, col-lg-*, col-xl-*, col-xxl-* classes) and html/gridrow (flex direction row/column/reversed, vertical alignment align-items-*, horizontal alignment justify-content-*, flex wrap/nowrap, and dynamic add column button).

title: Bootstrap 5 Navigation, Breadcrumbs & Navbar
description: Registers modern Bootstrap 5 navigation elements: html/breadcrumbs (custom divider style variable --bs-breadcrumb-divider), html/breadcrumbitem, html/pagination, html/pageitem (LinkInput integration, active/disabled toggles), html/progress (w-25..100, striped, animated), and html/navbar (bg-body-secondary, bg-body-tertiary, me-auto, data-bs-toggle='collapse').

title: Base Component Definition, TagsInput & Display Controls
description: Defines master _base component and global palettes (bgcolorClasses, bgcolorSelectOptions). Sets up General inspector tab (Id, Title, Class with TagsInput autocomplete), Display section (Display modes block, flex, grid, table, etc., Position static/fixed/relative/absolute, offsets top/left/bottom/right, float, opacity range, background/text colors), and linked styles warning detector (multi-element selector conflict detector with highlight outline).

title: Device Visibility & Bootstrap CSS Variables Inspector
description: Defines ComponentDeviceVisibility (responsive screen visibility toggles: d-xs-none, d-sm-none, d-md-none, d-lg-none, d-xl-none, d-xxl-none) and config/bootstrap component (dynamically scans document stylesheets for --bs-* CSS variables, categorized by colors, typography, and dimensions, allowing live root CSS variable editing).

title: Common Spacing, Margin, Padding & Background Controls
description: Defines ComponentBaseMargin (top, right, bottom, left), ComponentBasePadding (top, right, bottom, left), Border (border-style, border-width, border-color), Border Radius (4 corners), and Background Image (Image URL, repeat, size cover/contain, position X/Y) inspector groups attached to _base with live StyleManager sync.

title: Common Typography & Dimensions Inspector Controls
description: Defines ComponentBaseTypography (font-size, font-weight 100..900, font-family with fontList, text-align left/center/right/justify, line-height, letter-spacing, text-decoration underline/overline/strike/style/color) and ComponentBaseSize (width, height, min-width, min-height, max-width, max-height with CssUnitInput) mixins attached to _base.

title: Content Boxes, Pricing, Code Editor & Rating Elements
description: Registers diverse atomic content elements: elements/icon-list, elements/divider, elements/separator, elements/Image box, elements/Icon box, elements/animated-headline, elements/price-table, elements/price-list, elements/reviews, elements/code (pre/code block with innerHTML textarea), elements/image-compare (interactive before/after slider with CSS var --value), and elements/rating (5-star review indicator).

title: Interactive Gallery Element (Masonry, Flex & CSS Grid)
description: Registers elements/gallery component featuring multiple layouts (Masonry column-count, Flex flex-basis, CSS Grid repeat(auto, 1fr)), fit image cover toggle, image shadows, hover effects, customizable horizontal/vertical gaps, and repeater ListInput for managing captions, titles, descriptions, and positions.

title: Interactive Flip Boxes, Counters, Testimonials & Swiper Loader
description: Registers interactive UI components: elements/flip-box (3D card flipping effect with front/back contents, horizontal/vertical flip modes), elements/counter, elements/testimonial, elements/social-icons (SVG social icon list with inline/unstyled toggles), and provides carouselAfterDrop global asset injector for Swiper JS/CSS bundles.

title: Navigation Tabs & Bootstrap Accordion Elements
description: Registers responsive multi-pane layout widgets: elements/tab (individual tab pane with ID, class, active state), elements/tabs (tab navigation bar with synchronized tab-content panes, random parent ID assignment on drop, and live preview switching), and elements/accordion (Bootstrap collapsible accordion with dynamic item addition/removal and flush mode).

title: Swiper Carousel & Touch Slider Elements
description: Registers high-performance touch slider widgets powered by Swiper: elements/carousel and elements/slider. Exposes rich configuration parameters including slidesPerView, spaceBetween, speed, delay, transition effects (fade, flip, cube, cards, creative), autoplay, autoHeight, centeredSlides, loop, pagination, scrollbar, direction, and multi-tier responsive breakpoints (mobile, tablet, landscape, laptop, desktop).

title: SVG Icons, Figures & Vector Graphics Elements
description: Registers advanced graphics and icon components: elements/figure (responsive figure with image, dimensions, featured toggle, caption), elements/font-icon (Line Awesome text class icon editor with size presets), elements/svg-image (scalable SVG loader with media modal SvgInput, width/height/stroke-width sliders, raw Code textarea, and fill/color/stroke color controls), and elements/svg-element (path, rect, circle styling controls).

title: HTML Base Containers, Headings & Links Component Registry
description: Defines foundational HTML components in the 'Base' component group. Registers html/div, html/span (with innerHTML textarea editor), html/heading (supporting H1-H6 dynamic tag switching via changeNodeName and innerHTML), and html/link (anchors with href LinkInput, rel, innerHTML, target options, and download attributes).

title: HTML Audio, PDF, Objects, Meta & Iframe Registry
description: Registers rich media embed nodes: html/audio (figure wrapper with audio src, autoplay, loop), html/pdf (object tag embedding application/pdf), html/embed (generic object embed), html/html (full page title and meta description/keywords manager), and html/iframe (iframe container with src, width, and height CssUnitInputs).

title: HTML Form Container & Actions Registry
description: Registers standard html/form element container with pre-structured email/password inputs, check fields, and action buttons. Exposes inspector properties for action URL, method (GET/POST), and enctype (urlencoded, multipart/form-data, text/plain).

title: HTML Form Input Fields, Selects & Horizontal Rules
description: Registers basic HTML form controls including html/hr (styled horizontal divider with Bootstrap border colors border-1..5 and opacity), html/label (for attribute binding), html/textinput (supports 23 native input types like email, number, tel, date, text), html/selectinput (dynamic option list builder with add/remove actions), and html/textareainput (cols, rows, placeholder).

title: HTML Choice Inputs & HTML5 Video Registry
description: Registers selectable HTML input components and native video player: html/radiobutton (form-check radio options with checked state), html/checkbox (form-check default checkbox), and html/video (native video tag with src, poster, width/height, loop, autoplay, muted, playsinline, controls, and notice warning).

title: HTML Media & Responsive Image Component Registry
description: Registers pure responsive html/image component supporting automatic lazy/eager loading toggle (Featured Image switch), automatic srcset/data-src management, unwrapPictureTag helper, alignment controls (start/center/end), and optional wrapping anchor link. Automatically handles DPR and high fetchpriority flags.

title: HTML5 Semantic Layout & Text Nodes Registry
description: Registers HTML5 structural and formatting elements: html/nav, html/main, html/article, html/aside, html/details (accordion details/summary), html/summary, html/figcaption (figure caption), and html/inline-text (matches strong, b, em, i, u, s, small, mark, sub, sup tags).

title: HTML Data Tables & Grid Structure Registry
description: Registers comprehensive HTML table structure components: html/table (classes for table-striped, table-hover, table-primary/dark/light, table-sm, table-bordered, responsive toggle), html/tablerow (tr classes success, danger, active), html/tablecell (td), html/tableheadercell (th), html/tablebody (tbody), html/tablefooter (tfooter), and html/tablehead (thead).

title: HTML Typography, Buttons, Quotes & Lists Registry
description: Registers core HTML typographic nodes: html/button (native button with type submit/reset/button and autofocus), html/paragraph (text alignment text-start/center/end), html/blockquote (quote cite and text align), html/list-item (li item innerHTML), html/list (dynamic ul/ol node name switcher with ListInput item repeater), and html/preformatted (code/pre text display).

title: PayPal Donate, Facebook Page, Chart.js & Lottie Widgets
description: Registers dynamic widgets: widgets/paypal (PayPal donate form with business email, item name, number, currency code), widgets/facebookpage (Facebook Page timeline plugin), widgets/chartjs (interactive Chart.js canvas with live charts: line, bar, pie, doughnut, polarArea, bubble, scatter, radar), and widgets/lottie (Bodymovin Lottie vector animations with JSON path, loop, and autoplay).

title: Google Maps & OpenStreetMap Embedded Widgets
description: Registers interactive map embed components: widgets/googlemaps (iframe embed with address query, roadmap/satellite map type t, zoom level 1-20, API key) and widgets/openstreetmap (iframe embed with bounding box bbox parameters and mapnik layer). Both feature resizable canvas handles and CSS resize mode.

title: Multi-Provider Video Embed Widget (YouTube, Vimeo & HTML5)
description: Registers widgets/embed-video component supporting automatic provider detection (YouTube, Vimeo, HTML5) from video ID or URL. Exposes controls for poster image, custom width/height dimensions, autoplay, playsinline, loop, controls, mute, and displays browser autoplay compliance notices.

title: Facebook Comments & Twitter Embed Widgets
description: Registers social media embed widgets: widgets/facebookcomments (loads Facebook JS SDK and embeds fb-comments widget with href, numposts, colorscheme, order-by, and width parameters) and widgets/twitter (Twitter tweet embed iframe with dynamic Tweet ID parser from tweet URLs).

title: Virtual AST Parser & Tree Controller
description: Virtual HTML AST Engine and DOM-to-AST bidirectional bridge. Parses raw HTML or live DOM trees into deterministic AST nodes with stable data-ast-id preservation across syncDom() passes (reusing existing IDs and disambiguating cloned duplicates), provides structural mutators (moveNode, cloneNode, removeNode), and serializes clean HTML via js-beautify while stripping editor preview artifacts.

title: Breadcrumb Hierarchy Navigator Bar
description: Canvas bottom breadcrumb hierarchy navigator. Dynamically parses active DOM ancestry chain from selected element up to document body and renders clickable, hoverable breadcrumb items (.breadcrumb-item) for parent navigation.

title: Canvas Engine & Iframe Life Cycle Controller
description: Core canvas engine responsible for iframe initialization with default 1920x1080 Full HD desktop viewport and translate(-50%, -50%) absolute centering, preview URL routing, control/section/block/style groups rendering in sidebar panels, zoom scale handling (#iframe-wrapper), zero-scroll lock enforcement on outer canvas, and real-time bounding box tracking for #select-box on iframe window scroll and resize events.

title: Canvas Content Loader & HTML Node Selector
description: Canvas content loader handling iframe load events (_frameLoaded), editor helper stylesheet injection (vvvebjs-editor-helpers.css), event dispatching (Vvveb.iframe.loaded, Vvveb.Builder.selectNode), element type parsing (_getElementType), property panel binding (loadNodeComponent), and directional DOM tree navigation (moveNodeUp, moveNodeDown, cloneNode, selectNode) with dynamic badge updates and context-action buttons.

title: CodeMirror 6 Multi-Tab Code Editor & Live Sync
description: Multi-tab code editor controller combining HTML (Vvveb.CodeEditor), CSS (Vvveb.CssEditor), and JS (Vvveb.JsEditor) with CodeMirror. Provides live two-way synchronization with canvas DOM, AST cursor selection highlighting, dirty tracking isDirty with pending timer flush() mechanisms, and modal tab lifecycle management (#codeEditorModal).

title: System Color Palette & CSS Variables Inspector
description: Color Palette and CSS Custom Properties manager. Scans active document stylesheets for CSS variables (--bs-*, colors, fonts, dimensions), builds global palette stores (Vvveb.ColorPalette), and populates color pickers with theme color tokens.

title: Component Registry & Property Inspector Renderer
description: Component Registry and Property Inspector rendering engine. Manages registration (add, extend, get), component matching by tag name, attributes, and class regex (matchNode), and renders sidebar inspector controls into tabbed panels. Enforces Strict Hooking Filter to only bind Text, ID, Class, Title, and direct HTML attributes while strictly preventing accidental scanning of inline/computed CSS into property configs.

title: Engine Default Configuration & System Fonts
description: Default configuration settings loader (Vvveb.Config) and standard system fallback font definitions (fontList: Arial, Georgia, Times New Roman, Tahoma, Verdana, Courier New, etc.).

title: Content Manager, DOM Traverser & Tree Builder
description: Content manipulation utility (getAttr, setAttr, setHtml, getHtml, setText, getText) and DOM hierarchy traversal engine (getNodeTree, drawComponentsTree). Traverses live canvas DOM while skipping non-visual tags (SCRIPT, STYLE, LINK, META, NOSCRIPT, TEMPLATE) and helper elements, enforces blackbox boundary protection for WP shortcodes/blocks/post-content, pairs data-ast-id with tree nodes, encapsulates tree labels in a unified .tree-node-text wrapper with browser tooltip title, and renders tree navigator list markup with action buttons (clone, delete).

title: Core Helpers, Templating & Base Configuration
description: Foundational JavaScript helper library providing John Resig micro-templating engine tmpl(), query parameter serialization nestedFormData() and buildParams(), timer delay(), element detection isElement(), template HTML element generation generateElements(), DOM element viewport offset calculation offset(), smooth scrolling scrollToNode(), default component configurations, base and icon path resolution, and global registry groups.

title: Fast Incremental DOM Morphing Engine
description: High-performance Morphdom-inspired non-destructive DOM diffing and morphing engine. Efficiently reconciles canvas iframe DOM tree with updated HTML strings or virtual AST structures while preserving active media (video/audio playback, canvas state), Swiper sliders, animations, contenteditable selections, and transient builder helper overlays (#vvvebjs-new-section, #highlight-box, #select-box, data-vvveb-helpers).

title: Sidebar Drag & Drop, HTML Serialization & Persistence
description: Component drag-and-drop orchestration engine from sidebar to canvas with zoom-aware coordinate translation. Provides clean HTML serialization getHtml() with extension/helper stripping (removeHelpers), DOM morphing payload injection setHtml() with CSS/JS scoped extraction and AST synchronization, reusable component saving saveElement(), and AJAX persistence save().

title: File Manager, Page Hierarchy & Routing Controller
description: File Manager managing hierarchical folders (Pages, Templates, Template Parts, Reusable Blocks) in left sidebar. Handles page addition, deletion, renaming/duplication, single-open accordion folder state persistence (saveActiveFolder, restoreFolderStates), smooth scrolling to active page in tree, and page loading through AJAX/iframe routing without full page reload.

title: Dynamic Google & Web Fonts Manager
description: Dynamic web fonts manager supporting Google Fonts and custom font providers. Populates the typography dropdown selector (#font-family), dynamically loads requested font stylesheets on canvas, and tracks active font usage per DOM node to purge unused fonts (cleanUnusedFonts).

title: Blocks, Sections & Styles Groups Registry
description: Centralized registry stores for Blocks (Vvveb.Blocks), Sections (Vvveb.Sections), and Styles (Vvveb.Styles). Supports adding, retrieving, and querying preset presets by style href or identifier.

title: GUI Panel Toggles, Tree Navigator Layout & Dark Mode
description: Sub-module of Vvveb.Gui managing toggle states for File Manager, Left Column, Right Column Inspector (with responsive width adjustments and no-right-panel layout classes), Tree Navigator docking modes (floating canvas vs sidebar panel), Dark Mode switching with theme persistence, dynamic auto-fit zoom scaling calcFitZoom, setViewport breakpoint dispatcher, and CSS pseudo-class state selection.

title: Master GUI Controller, Viewports & Keyboard Shortcuts
description: Master GUI controller managing theme initialization (setTheme), keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+E, Ctrl+Shift+P, Ctrl+Shift+S, Delete/Backspace), undo/redo dispatching, save modal & AJAX saving, standardized Full HD 1920x1080 desktop viewport with translate(-50%, -50%) scale matrix and window resize auto-fit listener, responsive viewport breakpoint switching (mobile 375px, tablet 768px, desktop 1920x1080) with icon synchronization and auto select-box reflow, search filtering in component palettes, new page/section dialogs, and layout panel toggling.

title: Highlight Box, Element Hover & Live Drag Tracker
description: RAF-throttled hover highlight box and interactive drag/resize manager for canvas elements. Adjusts coordinates according to zoom scale transform matrix, provides smooth element resize handles (top-left, center, bottom-right, etc.), handles mousemove drop target calculation with block/leaf element heuristics, and initiates inline WYSIWYG editing on double-click.

title: Page-Scoped Custom JavaScript Manager
description: Page-scoped custom JavaScript manager. Computes neutral scoped script element IDs (script-page-{slug}, script-template-{slug}, script-part-{slug}, script-block-{slug}), handles backward compatibility migration for legacy script IDs, and dynamically injects/executes custom scripts in the canvas iframe <head> with auto-cleanup when empty.

title: New Section Dock & Floating Component Inserter
description: Manages bottom canvas persistent insertion dock (<newsection id="vvvebjs-new-section">) and modal dialogs (#add-section-box) for adding new sections, blocks, or HTML base components with context-aware insertion positioning (before footer, after main, or inside active container).

title: Section List Accordion & SortableJS Swap Controller
description: Left sidebar section manager rendering top-level canvas structural sections (header, main, section, footer, nav). Integrates SortableJS Swap mode (swap: true, swapClass: sortable-swap-highlight) for whole-section reordering, handles section addition (addSectionBtn) with semantic insertion heuristics, and records swap/move mutations for full undo/redo compatibility.

title: Multi-Selection Manager & Batch Element Actions
description: Multi-selection and batch element manipulation controller. Implements descendant element pruning (pruneDescendantElements), simultaneous multi-element selection (selectMultipleNodes, clearSelection), DOM-first batch deletion (deleteSelectedNodes) and batch cloning (cloneSelectedNodes) with Vvveb.Undo mutation recording, data-reuse-block ID disambiguation (_disambiguateReuseBlockDom), data-allow-overwrite attribute toggling, and contextual action bar bindings.

title: Style List Accordion & Theme Style Applicator
description: Style presets manager in the left panel. Dynamically applies selected preset stylesheets into canvas iframe <head> as <link id="vvvebjs-theme-style"> and maintains active state selection across page loads.

title: Style Manager & Scoped CSS Synchronization
description: CSS style manager and dynamic stylesheet injector. Resolves unique element selectors (getSelectorForElement), computes neutral scoped style IDs (style-page-{slug}, style-template-{slug}, style-part-{slug}, style-block-{slug}), manages responsive media query breakpoints (mobile 375px, tablet 768px, desktop) with mediaText parsing, generates clean CSS rules generateCss(), and injects realtime styles into <head> with disabled automatic computed style sniffing to preserve pure stylesheets.

title: DOM Tree Navigator & Multi-Selection Controller
description: Floating and dockable DOM Tree Navigator. Handles draggable header positioning, AST-synchronized DOM stamping via syncDom(), single selection, Ctrl/Cmd+click multi-selection toggle (toggleSelectComponent), Shift+click range selection (rangeSelectComponent), automatic node reconnection via _astId on click/hover, expandedAstIds state tracking, and node duplication/deletion.

title: Tree Navigator Coalesced Renderer & State Preserver
description: Coalesced requestAnimationFrame render scheduler for Vvveb.TreeList.loadComponents(). Batches multiple loadComponents() calls within the same animation frame into a single _renderTree() pass, preserves .tree container scrollTop to prevent visual jumping, maintains expandedAstIds checkbox states across DOM updates, supports { sync: true } immediate flushing, and queues pending selectComponent(node) calls.

title: DOM Tree Navigator SortableJS 3-Zone Drag-Drop
description: SortableJS drag-and-drop integration for Tree Navigator with 3-Zone Hit Testing on 26px row labels: Top 25% (Drop BEFORE), Middle 50% (Drop INSIDE/nest child), Bottom 25% (Drop AFTER). Executes direct DOM-first manipulation (insertBefore/appendChild), enforces circular move and void element guards, auto-expands target container on inside drop, records Undo move mutations, and selects moved nodes by direct DOM reference.

title: Inline Canvas WYSIWYG Text Editor
description: Floating inline rich-text WYSIWYG editor controller operating directly on canvas iframe elements via contenteditable. Manages formatting commands (bold, italic, underline, strike, link, text color, background color, font size, font family, justification, line breaks), font provider synchronization via FontsManager, and records characterData undo mutations upon editor destruction.

title: Advanced Controls (Color, Section, List, Autocomplete, Tags & Notice)
description: Advanced inspector controls: ColorInput (RGB-to-HEX converter with ColorPalette integration), ButtonInput, SectionInput (accordion container separator), ListInput (dynamic repeater with add/remove/select actions), AutocompleteInput, AutocompleteList, TagsInput (tokenized class tag editor), and NoticeInput.

title: Base Input Prototype & Event Dispatcher
description: Abstract base prototype object Input for all inspector input controls. Provides template rendering (renderTemplate, render), event binding for input changes, safe empty value handling (setValue), and custom propertyChange event dispatching.

title: Grid Layout & Products Input Controls
description: Grid layout configuration controls: GridLayoutInput, ProductsInput, and GridInput for column spanning and responsive layout selectors.

title: Smart Link Picker & REST Search Autocomplete Control
description: Smart link picker and WordPress REST API search control. Features debounced live search for posts/pages/custom post types via /wp-json/align-builder/v1/search-links, dual-mode views (Unlocked: direct URL typing; Locked: post ID & title card with badge), and disconnect unlinking.

title: Image, Video, SVG & File Upload Inputs
description: Media asset controls: ImageInput (URL text and local FileReader data-URL upload), VideoInput, SvgInput (inline SVG fetch, replacement, and attribute preservation), and FileUploadInput.

title: Number, Range Slider & CSS Unit Controls
description: Numeric and unit controls: DateInput, RangeInput (synchronized slider and number input), NumberInput (step input), and CssUnitInput (composite number input + unit dropdown: px, %, em, rem, vh, vw, auto).

title: Select, Radio, Button Group & AJAX List Inputs
description: Choice and selection controls: SelectInput (dropdown select), IconSelectInput, HtmlListSelectInput (cached AJAX dynamic HTML list with live search and resilient 404 network fallbacks), RadioInput, and RadioButtonInput (segmented button group).

title: Text, Textarea & Value Inputs
description: Text editing inspector controls: TextInput (single-line input), TextareaInput (multi-line textarea with safe empty value reset), ValueTextInput, and TextValueInput.

title: Checkbox & Toggle Switch Inputs Controller (Null-Safe on/off)
description: Defines CheckboxInput and ToggleInput components with robust null-safe fallback for on/off properties, boolean/string setValue normalization, and responsive switch UI binding.

title: oEmbed & Media URL Transformation Engine
description: Comprehensive oEmbed resolution and URL transformation engine supporting 25+ providers (YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Flickr, Twitter/X, SoundCloud, Spotify, Imgur, TikTok, TED, Reddit, Kickstarter, Amazon, Google Maps). Transforms direct media URLs into responsive iframe embeds or queries oEmbed API endpoints.

title: AI Assistant Modal & OpenAI ChatGPT Integration
description: Provides an interactive AI assistant toolbar button (#ai-assistant-btn) and modal popup (#ai-assistant-modal) connecting to OpenAI ChatGPT completions API (gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct). Enables generating Bootstrap 5 content from text prompts, grabbing canvas node innerHTML, and inserting/replacing canvas elements with undo history tracking.

title: Animate On Scroll (AOS) Extension & Lifecycle Handlers
description: Integrates Animate On Scroll (AOS) library with Vvveb builder: registers ComponentBaseAnimateScroll inspector section (Animation type fade/flip/slide/zoom, Duration range, Delay range, Play animation trigger), sanitizes/cleans aos-animate and aos-init classes before save, and restores them after serialization.

title: Coloris Color Picker Input Controller
description: Integrates Coloris advanced popup color picker into the builder's ColorInput component. Provides polaroid theme, formatToggle, color value synchronization with text input, and inline color indicator badge.

title: Custom Blocks Creator & LocalStorage Persistence Subsystem
description: Manages user-created custom HTML/CSS/JS blocks (Vvveb.CustomBlocks). Includes LocalStorage persistence, cleanWrapper for stripping redundant outer containers, cleanBlockHtml for sanitizing HTML structure, addBlockToVvveb for registering into Vvveb.Blocks and Vvveb.BlocksGroup['Custom'] with afterDrop hook for StyleManager and JsManager asset injection, and renders '+ Add' UI button in the Custom sidebar header.

title: System & Standard Fonts List Provider
description: Registers standard web and system font stacks (System Default, Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Arial, Helvetica, Times New Roman, Georgia, Courier New, Verdana, Tahoma, Trebuchet MS) into Vvveb.FontsManager under the 'system' provider group.

title: Media Input Bridges: ImageInput, VideoInput & SvgInput
description: Provides unified input connectors for media assets in inspector panels: ImageInput (resolveImgUrl URL normalization with fallback to picsum/placeholders, setValue, onImageChange, onClick opening MediaModal), VideoInput (video tag thumbnail and selector), and SvgInput (inline SVG fetcher and DOM replacer with attribute preservation).

title: Section, Header & Footer Structural Component Definition
description: Assembles complete section properties (ComponentSectionContent combining layout, background, overlay, top/bottom separators) and registers elements/section, elements/header, and elements/footer with intelligent componentsInit handler that detects and activates appropriate inspector tabs based on canvas DOM state.

title: Section Background Media, Overlay & SVG Separator Controls
description: Defines rich section background properties: SectionBackground (radio mode none/image/video/youtube, image source, video MP4/poster, YouTube embed URL, and parallax toggle), SectionOverlay (color and opacity range slider), and sectionSeparatorProperties generator (custom SVG top/bottom separators with icon picker, width/height, stroke width, fill, and stroke colors).

title: Section Layout & Container Width/Height Properties
description: Defines core section layout properties (SectionContent): section label (aria-label), container width toggle (Boxed container vs Full container-fluid), and container height toggle (Auto vs Full vh-100). Also provides media template constants for background video, youtube, and SVG separators.

title: Section Presets: 3-4 Column Multi-Portfolio Layouts
description: Registers multi-column portfolio section presets in Vvveb.Sections: 'bootstrap4/portfolio-three-column' (3-column responsive card grid for projects) and 'bootstrap4/portfolio-four-column' (4-column 8-item dense project grid with pagination bar).

title: Section Presets: About Team & 1-2 Column Portfolios
description: Registers preset full-page section templates in Vvveb.Sections: 'bootstrap4/about-team' (header hero unit with 4-column team member cards), 'bootstrap4/portfolio-one-column' (single-column project showcases with images, descriptions, CTA buttons, and pagination), and 'bootstrap4/portfolio-two-column' (2-column responsive project grid).

title: MutationObserver-Compatible Undo / Redo Engine
description: Central MutationObserver-compatible Undo/Redo mutation manager. Tracks discrete DOM and state mutations across childList additions/removals, characterData text changes, attribute/style modifications, node reordering (move), and whole-section swapping (swap), dispatching vvveb.undo.add and vvveb.undo.restore events for real-time TreeList and SectionList synchronization.

title: Media Thumbnail Cards, File Type Icons & Dropzone CSS
description: Styles media gallery elements: thumbnail image sizing, floating hover preview popup (.preview), colorful CSS icon shapes for 30+ file formats (.f-jpg, .f-png, .f-pdf, .f-zip, .f-mp4, .f-doc, .f-js, .f-css, .f-xls), and upload dropzone (.upload-collapse) button styles.

title: Media Modal Layout, Sticky Toolbar & Breadcrumbs CSS
description: Styles the Media Modal container layout: #MediaModal sizing (min-height 50vh), breadcrumb styling with color variables, sticky top-right header toolbar, search box icon states, and responsive modal breakpoints (<965px).

title: Media Modal Master Aggregator Stylesheet
description: Master CSS aggregator importing media-modal-layout.css and media-grid-thumbnails.css via @import rules for clean modal presentation.

title: Media Library Entrypoint & Namespace
description: Master JavaScript entrypoint declaring window.Vvveb media namespace and documenting the modular breakdown of the media controller subsystem into media-modal-controller.js, media-file-manager.js, and media-upload-manager.js.

title: Media Modal Folder Navigation & Search Engine
description: Extends MediaModal.prototype with path navigation methods: goto(hash) for parsing URL hash parameters, generateBreadcrumbs(nextDir) for clickable folder paths, searchByPath(dir) for locating nested folders, and searchData(data, searchTerms) for recursive search through the file tree.

title: Media Modal Core Controller & Lifecycle Orchestrator
description: Defines MediaModal class constructor, modal HTML generation, gallery initialization, hashchange routing, search input binding, file selection save callback dispatch, and custom event orchestration (mediaModal:init, mediaModal:fileActions).

title: Media Modal Upload Dropzone, File Render & File Operations
description: Extends MediaModal.prototype with file manipulation and rendering methods: onUpload (FileReader + FormData AJAX upload with loading spinner), deleteFile, renameFile, addFile (generates thumbnail cards, file type badges, rename/delete buttons, and hover preview popup), render (renders folder and file lists, breadcrumbs), escapeHTML, and bytesToSize.

title: OpenVerse CC Stock Photo Search Integration
description: Integrates OpenVerse API stock photo search into MediaModal: OpenVerse client with OAuth token auth and filter parameters (license, license_type, categories, aspect_ratio, size, source), and OpenVerseDisplay UI controller (search form, filter accordion, thumbnail card rendering with license attribution, and pagination).

title: Bottom Breadcrumb & Code Editor Trigger Bar Partial
description: Renders the bottom horizontal status bar (#bottom-panel). Houses the active DOM element breadcrumb navigator (.breadcrumb-navigator) and the Code Editor launch button (#code-editor-btn) with shortcut Ctrl + E.

title: Canvas Iframe & Visual Overlay Partial
description: Renders the live editing canvas (#canvas) containing iframe wrapper (#iframe-wrapper), the iframe element (#iframe1), and the interactive overlay layer (#iframe-layer). Contains the loading blob animation (.loading-message), hover highlight box (#highlight-box), selection box (#select-box) with resize handles and inline WYSIWYG editor (#wysiwyg-editor), drop target indicator (#drop-highlight-box), and the modal popup container (#add-section-box).

title: Builder Document Head Partial
description: Contains metadata, document title ('Align Builder'), viewport configuration, and stylesheet links for master editor stylesheet (css/editor.css) and canvas helper stylesheet (css/vvvebjs-editor-helpers.css).

title: Basic Input Templates & Safe Toggle Switch Definition
description: HTML micro-templates for basic input types: textinput, textareainput, checkboxinput, radiobuttoninput, toggle (with safe typeof checks on/off), header, and dateinput.

title: Container, Property & Section Micro-Templates
description: Defines Resig micro-templates for section accordion headers (vvveb-input-sectioninput, vvveb-input-popoverinput), property grid wrapper (vvveb-property), autocomplete list (vvveb-input-autocompletelist), tags input (vvveb-input-tagsinput), alert notices (vvveb-input-noticeinput), and draggable section items (vvveb-section).

title: Media Gallery, Color & CSS Unit Micro-Templates
description: Defines Resig micro-templates for range sliders (vvveb-input-rangeinput), image file upload (vvveb-input-imageinput), image gallery selector with preview thumbnail (vvveb-input-imageinput-gallery), SVG gallery (vvveb-input-svginput-gallery), video gallery (vvveb-input-videoinput-gallery), native color picker with palette (vvveb-input-colorinput-native), Coloris picker (vvveb-input-colorinput), number input (vvveb-input-numberinput), action button (vvveb-input-button), and CSS unit picker (vvveb-input-cssunitinput with px/rem/%/vw/vh).

title: Select, Dropdowns & Responsive Grid Micro-Templates
description: Defines Resig micro-templates for select dropdowns with optgroups (vvveb-input-select), icon selectors (vvveb-input-icon-select), HTML list select (vvveb-input-html-list-select, vvveb-input-html-list-dropdown), sortable list input (vvveb-input-listinput), Bootstrap responsive column grid spans (vvveb-input-grid for col/sm/md/lg/xl/xxl), and key-value pair rows (vvveb-input-textvalue).

title: Left Panel Drawer & FileManager Navigator Partial
description: Renders the expandable left drawer (#left-panel). Houses the Pages/FileManager tree (#filemanager) with Add Item dropdown (#add-item-dropdown: Add Page, Add Template, Add Template Part, Add Reusable block), the DOM Tree Navigator (#tree-list), Components registry panel (#components), Blocks pane, Sections list (#sections), Style presets (#styles-tab), and Palette variables.

title: Multi-Tab CodeMirror 6 Code Editor Modal Partial
description: Renders the CodeMirror 6 Multi-Tab Code Editor modal (#codeEditorModal) with tabs for HTML (#code-tab), CSS (#csscode-tab), and JS (#jscode-tab), Live Sync status badge (#code-editor-sync-badge), export HTML modal (#textarea-modal), saved confirmation modal (#message-modal), legacy new page modal, and save offcanvas (#save-offcanvas).

title: Revision Comparison Studio Fullscreen Modal Partial
description: Fullscreen minimalist modal partial for comparing revision snapshots side-by-side (50%/50% dual iframe canvas) or in single preview mode, featuring dual compact dropdown selectors, master scrollbar track, and instant revision rollback action button.

title: System Modals, CRUD Dialogs & Toasts Partial
description: Renders system modals including Heartbeat session login modal (#heartBeatLogin), Save toast notifications (#top-toast, #bottom-toast), Add New Item modal (#align-create-item-modal), Rename Item modal (#align-rename-item-modal), and Custom Block modal (#customBlockModal).

title: Right Inspector Properties Panel Partial
description: Renders the right inspector sidebar (.component-properties) featuring tabbed controls: Content (#content-tab), Style (#style-tab with pseudo-state selector hover/active/nth-of-type), and Advanced (#advanced-tab). Dynamically populated with input controls and the Content Overwrite accordion.

title: Builder Engine Scripts & Bundles Loader Partial
description: Assembles and enqueues all builder runtime JavaScript modules: Popper, Bootstrap, SortableJS, CM6-Lezer bundle, Vvveb Core Engine (24 modules), Inspector input controllers, media gallery, Coloris color picker, HTML/Elements/Bootstrap/Widget components, presets, plugins, and bootstraps Vvveb.Gui.init() and Vvveb.FileManager.init().

title: Sidebar Navigation Bar Partial
description: Renders the left-most icon sidebar navigation containing the site logo/fallback badge (#wp-site-icon, #fallback-align-badge) and tab switches for Pages (#pages-tab), Components (#components-tab), Sections (#sections-tab), Style (#configuration-tab), and Properties (#properties-tab).

title: FileManager & Tree Item Micro-Templates Partial
description: Defines Resig micro-templates (type='text/html') for FileManager folders (#vvveb-filemanager-folder), page items (#vvveb-filemanager-page with tag labels, 1-click copy-id button for Reusable blocks, rename/delete/duplicate buttons), component links (#vvveb-filemanager-component), and breadcrumbs (#vvveb-breadcrumb-navigaton-item).

title: Master Input Templates Aggregator Stub
description: Serves as the root entrypoint and fallback for input templates, which are modularly assembled from partials/inputs/*.html by Class_Builder_UI_Renderer.

title: Top Action Toolbar Panel Partial
description: Renders the top fixed horizontal header bar (#top-panel). Contains layout toggles, Undo/Redo buttons (#undo-btn, #redo-btn), Reusable Block shortcode pill container (#top-panel-shortcode-container), centered selection action toolbar (#select-actions with badge, up, down, clone, delete, overwrite toggle), Dark Mode toggle (.btn-dark-mode), preview external link, responsive breakpoint buttons (mobile, tablet, desktop), zoom input, and primary Save button (.save-btn).

title: Builder Headless Registration & Gutenberg Assets Loader
description: Registers headless WordPress Admin page for Gutenberg embedded iframe, intercepts standalone builder page routing with multi-tier no-cache headers (DONOTCACHEPAGE, no-store, litespeed_disable_all), pre-populates default Custom HTML block content on new pages, and centrally enqueues 6 Gutenberg and Site Editor (FSE) integration assets.

title: Builder Asset Cleaner & Disk Garbage Collector
description: Manages automated garbage collection of external CSS/JS files and disk template files. Hooks into 'before_delete_post' to clean assets for deleted Pages, Reusable Blocks ('wp_block'), Templates ('wp_template'), and Template Parts ('wp_template_part'). Supports legacy asset file cleanup, candidate slug/ID resolution, and migration/purging of legacy 'align-' prefixed files.

title: Builder Asset Loader & Dynamic Block Auto-Discovery Engine
description: Manages builder canvas asset loading, user-configured external scripts and stylesheets from the Asset Loader tab, and automatic discovery of dynamic Gutenberg block assets (style.css, script.js) for injection into iframe canvas and Shadow DOM previews.

title: Builder Content Fetcher, Preview Canvas Engine & Link Resolver
description: Retrieves structured lists of Pages, FSE Templates, Template Parts, and Reusable Blocks for the file tree navigator. Assembles and serves live Canvas HTML for iframe editing with strict no-cache headers, dynamic timestamp versioning for preview theme CSS/JS, font preloads, extracted scoped CSS/JS tags, and dummy image replacements. Strips FSE wp:template-part tags for template canvas isolation, parses live component previews via DOMDocument/DOMXPath, searches published posts for link picker, and resolves dynamic link IDs.

title: Builder CRUD Operations, Dual-Write Persistence & Block/Shortcode Renderer
description: Handles saving, creating, renaming, and deleting Pages, Templates, Template Parts, and Reusable Blocks. Implements Dual-Write persistence (saving to DB wp_posts and writing synchronized .html files to align-child/templates/ or parts/), sanitizes and saves '_align_reusable_overrides' post meta, minifies payload via Align_Builder_Minifier, wraps content in Gutenberg '<!-- wp:align/custom-html -->', and provides server-side rendering endpoints for shortcodes and Gutenberg blocks.

title: Tokenized & Cloud-Accelerated Asset & Markup Minifier
description: High-performance minification engine for HTML, CSS, and JS payloads. HTML minification protects sensitive elements (<pre>, <code>, <textarea>, <script>, <style>, <svg>) and Gutenberg comments with tokenized placeholders. CSS/JS minification uses a 3-tier pipeline: structural heuristic check for pre-minified code, two-tier caching (in-memory + WordPress transients 12h), Align Cloud API (/api/minify), and instant fallback to local tokenized engines with full observability logging.
events_and_hooks: Connects to external Cloud API: https://convertb.alignvn.cloud/api/minify

title: Builder REST API Router & Authentication Controller
description: Registers and routes all 9 REST API endpoints under namespace 'align-builder/v1' with capability ('edit_pages') and nonce ('wp_rest') permission checks. Enforces strict no-cache headers across all align-builder/v1 responses via rest_pre_serve_request. Provides backward-compatibility proxy methods delegating to Align_Builder_Content_Handler and Align_Builder_Crud_Handler.

title: Builder Revision History & Rollback Core Handler
description: Queries WordPress Core post revisions (wp_get_post_revisions) for Pages, Posts, Templates, and Template Parts, formats metadata with author avatar and human-readable time, and handles revision restoration (wp_restore_post_revision) with automatic disk template file synchronization and theme.json cache clearing.

title: Database Template & Template Part Duplicate Cleaner
description: Scans database records for 'wp_template' and 'wp_template_part' post types, groups posts by normalized base slug (stripping child/parent theme prefixes), keeps the most recent record as primary, re-standardizes slug and taxonomy terms ('wp_theme', 'wp_template_part_area'), deletes duplicate stale records, flushes theme.json cache, and outputs detailed cleanup statistics.

title: Builder UI Renderer, Partials Assembler & Config Injector
description: Assembles the complete standalone Builder UI HTML from 11 core partials and 4 modular input partials (or falls back to monolithic editor.html). Enforces strict no-cache headers (DONOTCACHEPAGE, no-store, expires 0), dynamically timestamps 100% of stylesheet links and script tags with ?v=timestamp via bust_builder_assets_cache, enqueues WordPress media modal scripts/styles, injects dynamic WordPress site icon favicon tags, and injects 'window.VvvebWpConfig' configuration object containing REST endpoints, active entity context, dummy image URLs, theme CSS URLs, and bootstraps client integration JS modules.

title: Align Builder Core Bootstrap & Facade Controller
description: Initializes core builder constants (ALIGN_BUILDER_SLUG, ALIGN_BUILDER_TITLE, ALIGN_BUILDER_REST_NS, ALIGN_BUILDER_PATH, ALIGN_BUILDER_URL), requires 7 builder submodules, binds post deletion garbage collection hook to Align_Builder_Asset_Cleaner, and provides backward-compatibility facade static methods for the entire builder subsystem.

title: Dynamic Image Srcset & Picture Art-Direction Resolver
description: Resolves dynamic image srcset, sizes, dimensions, and responsive 3-tier <picture> art-direction breakpoints strictly during editor canvas hydration in Align Builder. Implements in-memory metadata caching, cleans redundant inline styles (width: 100%; height: auto;), normalizes domain-agnostic relative URLs (/wp-content/uploads/...), and safely handles dummy placeholders, SVG icons, and orphaned attachments with zero frontend overhead.

title: Align ZIP Project Archive & Page Folder Scanner
description: Recursively scans unzipped HTML projects, discovers assets/ directory vs page folders, performs physical root unwrap (normalize_directory_to_root), collects 100% recursive media files (collect_all_media_files), identifies HTML/CSS/JS/Fonts/Media files, auto-detects home pages, formats clean slugs, and builds structured project catalogs.

title: Align ZIP Media Sideload, WebP Cloud Converter & URL Rewriter
description: Handles media extraction, WordPress attachment sideloading, automated WebP conversion via Align Cloud API with fallback, deduplication of old media, and HTML/CSS link rewriting with data-align-link-id support.

title: Align ZIP Page Assembler, Minifier & Gutenberg Block Packager
description: Creates fresh WordPress Pages, Global Template Parts (Header/Footer), and Reusable Blocks from HTML projects. Enforces deterministic asset type classification (Font/JS/CSS) in register_loaded_asset, extracts CDN assets, saves scoped external CSS/JS, and packages inside align/custom-html block.

title: Align ZIP Master Importer Controller & Factory Reset Engine
description: Master controller for HTML ZIP import and Factory Reset: handles ZIP file uploads, Zip Slip directory traversal security checks, executable blocking, temporary extraction, pipeline orchestration, and site data reset with plugin deactivation and custom asset purging.

title: Align Admin Settings Tab 8 View: HTML Project ZIP Importer & Reset
description: Admin view template for Tab 8: Drag & Drop upload zone, collapsible hierarchy guide, 3-row configuration options, live progress bar, collapsible terminal execution log, created pages datatable with Builder deep-links, and Factory Reset modal with DELETE input confirmation & 5-second countdown.

title: Align ZIP 2-Stage AI Template Refactor Specialist Engine (OpenRouter)
description: 2-Stage AI refactoring engine using OpenRouter Cloud API: Stage 1 extracts Global Header/Footer parts; Stage 2 extracts recurring Reusable Blocks. Injects deterministic Content Overwrite attributes (data-allow-overwrite, data-overwrite-id) and builder shortcode wrappers with SVG tokenization.

title: Align ZIP Chunked Multi-Step AJAX Batch Runner Engine
description: Non-blocking chunked AJAX batch runner for large ZIP imports: executes init_session, process_ai_refactor, process_media_batch, process_pages_batch, and second_pass steps with live progress tracking and deterministic memory cleanup.

title: Load Custom Assets Tab Controller & Drag-Drop Reorder Engine
description: Client-side controller for Tab 5 (Load Asset): manages 3-type filtering (Font, CSS, JS, All), real-time counter badges, HTML5 native drag-and-drop row reordering with visual drop indicators, automatic input re-indexing (align_loaded_assets[i]), and AJAX uploads/deletions.

title: Native Reusable Blocks (wp_block) Shortcode, Slug & REST Engine
description: Handles native WordPress Reusable Blocks (wp_block / Synced Patterns): renders [reuse-block id="..."] and [reuse-block slug="..."] shortcodes, exposes /align-reuse/v1/fields and /align-reuse/v1/blocks REST endpoints, and provides content overwrite merging.

title: Custom Asset Management, Upload & Deletion Backend Engine
description: Handles custom asset uploads (.css, .js, .woff2, .ttf...), MIME type allowances, root-relative URL normalizations, path security checks against directory traversal, permanent asset deletion, and integration with Core plugin assets (Lenis, Splide).

title: Align Admin Settings Tab 5 View: Load Custom Assets & Drag-Drop UI
description: Admin view template for Tab 5 (Load Asset): provides 3-type asset filter bar (All, CSS, JS, Font) with dynamic count badges, native OS file upload, drag-and-drop row reordering handles, and loading strategy selectors (Normal, Defer, Async, Delay).

title: WordPress Components Base Registrar & Shared Placeholders
description: Registers the WordPress category group in Vvveb.ComponentsGroup and Vvveb.BlocksGroup. Manages global placeholders and shared definitions for all WordPress components in Align Visual Builder.

title: WordPress Shortcode Component & Live REST Preview
description: Registers the "wordpress/shortcode" component with visual sidebar controls for shortcode markup and invokes WpComponentsPreview for real-time server-side shortcode rendering into Shadow DOM.

title: WordPress Gutenberg Block Component & Markup Serializer
description: Registers the "wordpress/block" component for Gutenberg block comments and synced patterns. Provides full-width Block Markup textarea and triggers live server-side block rendering.

title: WordPress Post Content Component & Universal FSE Dynamic Bridge
description: Registers the "wordpress/post-content" component for dynamic page/post/template content rendering in Full Site Editing (FSE) templates and pages.

title: WordPress Live Search Component & 1:1 Gutenberg Inspector Controls (Dynamic E-Commerce Auto-Detect & Custom HTML Dropdown)
description: Implements "wordpress/live-search" component and block preset for Align Builder. Clones 1:1 all Gutenberg inspector settings (Enable Live Search AJAX toggle, Search & Query Settings, Enable Query by Categories with dynamic auto-detection for e-commerce plugins like FluentCart/WooCommerce/EDD, Display Options, Technical & Redirection, Gutenberg Block Markup sync) with full-width stacked layout, live shadow DOM preview, aligned toggle switches, and dynamic taxonomy getters.

title: Align Live Search Block Schema & Metadata Definition
description: Defines Gutenberg block schema (apiVersion 3, name align/live-search, category align-category, icon search) with attributes for placeholder, postsPerPage, defaultMode, allowModeToggle, selectedPostTypes, enableCategoryFilter, categoryFilterTaxonomy, and styling supports.

title: Live Search Block Registration, REST Route & AJAX Handlers
description: Registers align/live-search block with editor and frontend scripts/styles, exposes REST API endpoint POST /align/v1/live-search with 60 req/min rate limiting, handles AJAX search query with 15-minute transient caching, and hooks automated cache eviction on post save/deletion.

title: Live Search Block Server-Side HTML Renderer & Lenis Scroll Protection
description: Server-side render callback for align/live-search block. Outputs semantic HTML search form, category dropdown filter, toggle modes, submit button, results container, and injects data-lenis-prevent attributes to guarantee smooth scroll isolation.

title: Live Search Client-Side Runtime & Event Isolation Controller
description: Client-side runtime for live search widgets. Handles 300ms debounced AJAX/REST querying, client-side in-memory caching, category dropdown listbox state management, mode switching, keyboard navigation, and isolates mousewheel/touch events from Lenis smooth scroll.

title: Align Studio Controller & Reusable Block REST API
description: Registers dedicated admin page admin.php?page=align-studio, provides REST API endpoints (/studio-draft, /studio-canvas, /export-studio-block), injects full theme stylesheets into sandbox iframe, strictly isolates Lenis smooth-scroll hijacking, and exports packaged wp_block.

title: Align Studio Core Controller & Viewport Sync Engine
description: Main client-side orchestrator for Align Studio. Manages iframe canvas lifecycle, 2-way live synchronization with CodeMirror 6, natural document scrolling, wheel forwarding across margins, dummy image fallbacks, and REST export requests.

title: Align Studio CodeMirror 6 Tri-Tab Code Editor
description: Wraps CodeMirror 6 bundle (cm6-lezer.bundle.min.js) into a 3-tab (HTML, CSS, JS) docked code editor with line numbers, dark theme, debounced 100ms synchronization to iframe sandbox, and HTML indentation beautifier.

title: Dynamic Block & Token SSR Renderer
description: Server-Side Rendering token resolution engine for Align Builder and Reusable Blocks. Hydrates post tokens (title, permalink, thumbnail, excerpt, date, category, author), site tokens, custom ACF/meta fields, and query loop repeaters (loop_items, max_pages) with live database data.

title: Studio Dynamic Tokens Manager & AI Auto-Bind
description: Client-side registry and manager for dynamic tokens in Align Studio. Provides categorized token list (Post, Loop, ACF, Site), live search filter, click-to-copy with timer race-condition cleanup, CodeMirror 6 text insertion, and trigger for AI auto-bind with optional user instruction.

title: Studio Dynamic Block AI Auto-Binder
description: Backend REST API endpoint and service for binding dynamic tokens to static HTML using AI microservice. Sanitizes optional user instructions, crafts strict system role prompt to preserve 100% HTML structure/classes, and returns token-bound template.

title: Align Builder Floating Context Menu Stylesheet
description: Styles the floating right-click context menu container (#align-builder-context-menu), header badge, action list items, keyboard shortcut tags, dividers, and hover/danger states.

title: Align Builder Right-Click Context Menu & Element Clipboard Controller
description: Implements right-click context menu in Canvas iframe and Navigator TreeList with bulletproof capture mode, element clipboard Copy/Paste, Duplicate, Move Up/Down, Hide/Unhide, and Delete.

title: Word Editor Mode Controller & Floating Bubble Toolbar
description: Controls Word Editor Mode for distraction-free document writing on blank canvas: auto-initializes document container (.align-document-container), manages floating bubble toolbar with smart clamping and dynamic arrow offset (--arrow-x), auto-flips below (.is-below) when near viewport top, suppresses builder highlight/select boxes, handles markdown shortcuts (#, ##, -, *, 1., >), gutter inserter (+), and image quick actions.

title: Word Editor Mode Canvas & Bubble Toolbar Stylesheet
description: Styles the distraction-free Word document paper container (.align-document-container), floating bubble toolbar (.word-bubble-toolbar) with dynamic arrow (--arrow-x) and top-boundary flip (.is-below), gutter quick inserter (.word-gutter-inserter), image alignment/resizing, and enforces strict suppression of Vvveb highlight/select boxes in Word mode.

title: Custom Layout Templates Subsystem Client Engine
description: Manages custom user/admin layout templates with two-tier sync (LocalStorage cache & WordPress REST API persistence). Injects dual action buttons (Cyan Edit button & Red Delete button) onto template cards, handles in-place template updates for HTML, Custom CSS, and Custom JS via modal #customTemplateModal, and decouples assets into StyleManager and JsManager via afterDrop hook.

title: Custom Layout Templates WordPress REST API Handler
description: Handles WordPress REST API endpoints (/wp-json/align-builder/v1/custom-templates) for fetching (GET), creating and updating in-place (POST), and deleting (DELETE) custom user/admin layout templates stored persistently in wp_options.

title: Media Size Tags & Responsive Image Breakpoints Subsystem
description: Provides interactive tag/chip picker for responsive media sub-sizes (limit 3) in Align Builder Inspector. Auto-sorts selected tags by width ascending and maps them to mobile , tablet , and desktop tags with data-align-sizes persistence.

title: Editor Mode Lock, Legacy Content Detector & Switch REST Endpoint
description: Enforces single-editor lock (_align_editor_locked) per post/page/CPT after first non-empty save via wp_after_insert_post (priority 25), lazy-detects legacy content on editor load via parse_blocks() with edit_post capability guard, blocks unauthorized _align_editor_mode and _align_editor_locked meta mutations via update_post_metadata/add_post_metadata/delete_post_metadata filters while allowing idempotent no-op writes, localizes AlignEditorModeConfig, and handles POST /wp-json/align-builder/v1/switch-editor-mode (revision backup, content clear, asset cleanup, mode switch).

title: Gutenberg & Builder Editor Mode Switch & Lock Client Controller
description: Manages active editor mode resolution ('gutenberg' | 'builder') across all eligible post types and FSE templates, enforces lock state by ignoring ?align_mode= and sessionStorage when locked, strips read-only _align_editor_locked before editPost({ meta }), disables the header switch button during save/autosave via wp.data.subscribe and AlignSaveCoordinator.isBusy(), prompts on dirty state, and renders sanitized destructive confirmation modal before calling POST /switch-editor-mode.

title: Single Save Coordinator & Two-Way Snapshot Bridge
description: Single Source of Truth coordinator managing saves between WordPress Gutenberg/Site Editor and Embedded Align Builder iframe. Handles in-flight save locking, exposes isBusy() for UI guards, delegates mode detection to AlignEditorModeSwitch.getActiveEditorMode, strips read-only _align_editor_locked before editPost({ meta }), bridges dirty state, and coordinates snapshot persistence.

title: Built-in Lightweight SEO Engine & Post Meta Registrar
description: Registers 7 REST-enabled _align_seo_* post meta keys (_align_seo_title, _align_seo_description, _align_seo_focus_keyword, _align_seo_canonical, _align_seo_robots, _align_seo_og_title, _align_seo_og_image) across all public post types, renders lightweight admin SEO metabox, outputs document title, meta description, canonical URL, wp_robots directives, and OpenGraph/Twitter tags with smart fallbacks, and automatically suppresses metabox/head output when Rank Math (RANK_MATH_VERSION) or Yoast (WPSEO_VERSION) is active.

title: Builder Asset History, Snapshot & Rollback Service
description: Provides automated history snapshots, pruning, listing, and restoration for CSS and JS assets prior to destructive overwrite or deletion operations. Enforces a 5-snapshot retention window and protects snapshots behind .htaccess and index.php stubs.

title: Builder Asset Writer & Disk Persister Engine
description: Handles atomic writes, minification, and safe deletion/synchronization of external CSS and JS assets on disk with snapshot history tracking. Exposes destructive save_external_assets for explicit saves and non-destructive sync_external_assets for content synchronization.

title: Builder Asset Synchronizer & Non-Destructive Migrator
description: Provides non-destructive migration and synchronization of scoped CSS and JS assets from post or template content to disk files. Returns early without deleting assets when content lacks inline tags in File-First mode.
